A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you
take a bite.

Is the meal finder free?

Yes. Use the finder without signing up or sharing personal details. Results update instantly.

Are these the final order prices?

No. Estimates use the menu's listed starting prices, checked on 8 October 2026. Extras, delivery fees and price changes are not included. Confirm the final amount on the ordering menu.

How does the finder choose my meal?

It filters a selection of baguettes, tacos, toasties and salads by your filling and food preference, adds your drink, and recommends the highest-priced matching option within your budget. If none fits, it shows the lowest starting total that matches your choices.

Can I find plant-based options?

Yes. Select Plant-based to explore the Vegan baguette, Tofu Tacos or Vegan Salad. Check ingredients and preparation with the restaurant if you have allergies or specific dietary needs.

Can I order pickup or delivery in Abuja?

The restaurant's menu lists pickup and delivery in Abuja. Use Order from the menu to confirm availability and delivery details for your location.
